normal: early UTC offset for a folded wall clock and roll forward across a missing hour
explicit five-field cron uses the same local calendar
freeze definition, original actor and route on unique schedule/UTC occurrence
neutral Main may send without accepting Work
private Work.goal supersedes the definition only after acceptance
faults: cold restart after acceptance and edit before delivery reuses the original occurrence
pause, update or lower max_runs never cancels accepted Work
do not issue a new DM send after assignment transfer
a SELF schedule has no human actor
overdue periodic schedule advances to one future occurrence after the original settles
reject ambiguous cron syntax, unknown zone and past once
